subject: RTP Labs discovery kickoff — logistics, attendees, and evidence checklist
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ava Simmons <ava@rtplabs.com>, Jamal Ortiz <j.ortiz@rtplabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + quick kickoff logistics for RTP Labs discovery

Hi Ava / Jamal —

Thanks for taking the time to run an initial discovery with us. Quick goal: align on success criteria, scope for a short technical demo, and any procurement/security gating items so we can come prepared.

Proposed 60-minute windows (PT):
- Tue 2027-03-30 10:00–11:00
- Wed 2027-03-31 14:00–15:00
- Thu 2027-04-01 11:00–12:00

Suggested attendees:
- Ava Simmons (Champion) — RTP Labs
- Jamal Ortiz (Engineering Lead) — RTP Labs
- Elena Ruiz (Procurement) — RTP Labs (if you need procurement items on the agenda)
- Security distro (security@rtplabs.com) — for evidence/questions
- Rafael Mendes, Account Exec — Redwood Inference
- Marissa Cole, Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
- Monica Patel, CSM (optional) — Redwood Inference

A few items it would help to have in advance (we can also cover during the call):
- Primary success metric for a pilot (latency, cost, accuracy)
- Any data access constraints (sample dataset we should use)
- Procurement checklist owner and contract cadence
- Security evidence checklist (SOC2, data residency, logging) — we attached our standard evidence request form for quick review (rtp-evidence-request-2027.pdf).

If one of the time slots above works, please reply with what you prefer and who from procurement/security should attend. If none work, propose 2–3 options and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this kicked off.

—
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.inference.com
Attachment: rtp-evidence-request-2027.pdf (PDF)
From: Ava Simmons <ava@rtplabs.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Jamal Ortiz <j.ortiz@rtplabs.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.procure@rtplabs.com>, security@rtplabs.com
Date: 2027-03-29T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + quick kickoff logistics for RTP Labs discovery

Thanks Rafael — happy to run this. Confirming attendees: me (Ava), Jamal (Eng lead), Elena (Procurement) and security@rtplabs.com will join if we need to surface evidence items.

We prefer afternoon slots due to engineering syncs. Wed 2027-03-31 14:00–15:00 PT works best for Jamal and me. Elena asked whether you can share a short mutual action plan ahead of time so procurement has a sense of timelines and expected deliverables. Also security asked if you can point to where your SOC2 report and data-retention policy live.

Can you also call out whether the demo will require any inbound network access to our VPC or sample data upload? Jamal would like to know if we need to provision a test dataset or temporary S3 access.

Thanks — Ava

Ava Simmons
Head of Product Operations | RTP Labs
ava@rtplabs.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ava Simmons <ava@rtplabs.com>, Jamal Ortiz <j.ortiz@rtplabs.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.procure@rtplabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>, security@rtplabs.com
Date: 2027-03-29T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + quick kickoff logistics for RTP Labs discovery

Hi all — great, wed 2027-03-31 14:00–15:00 PT is confirmed on our side. I just sent a calendar invite (see link below) — please accept when you have a chance.

Quick answers to Ava's questions:
- Evidence: our SOC2 summary and data-retention statement are linked here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDEfGhIJ-klmnoPqR (we'll also attach the summary to the calendar invite).
- Network/data for demo: For the discovery/demo we'll use a synthetic small sample — no inbound VPC peering or firewall changes required. If you want to test with real data in a later pilot, Jamal, we can coordinate a temporary S3 access or private deployment options.
- MAP: attached a short draft mutual action plan (draft-mutual-action-plan-rtp.docx) — it outlines a 4-week pilot cadence and procurement touchpoints. Elena, feel free to redline and we'll iterate.

Marissa — can you come prepared for a 20-minute technical deep-dive covering: sample request patterns, latency/throughput expectations, and a brief note on how Redwood handles KV cache and prefix caching? Also flag any items we should capture for Jamal's team.

Elena — if procurement prefers, we can put a separate 20-minute contract/terms sync after the demo; otherwise we can surface high-level procurement milestones in the MAP.

Meeting link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234rtp
Attachment: draft-mutual-action-plan-rtp.docx (DOCX)

—
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.inference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.inference.com>, Ava Simmons <ava@rtplabs.com>, Jamal Ortiz <j.ortiz@rtplabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.procure@rtplabs.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T17:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + quick kickoff logistics for RTP Labs discovery

Hi team — I accepted the invite. I’ll cover the technical deep-dive and bring a short list of configuration options (batching, quantization, and caching) plus a simple checklist Jamal can use if you want to try sample data later.

Jamal — could you confirm if you can provide a 2–3 GB sample or whether you prefer we demo with a synthetic dataset? If you do plan to provide S3 access, please share the bucket name and a contact for temporary creds.

Looking forward to it.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com
